data.action: 坐于床沿单手轻拢滑落的真丝晨袍，羞赧侧目
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the edge of a silk-draped bed beside sheer morning curtains, her ivory silk robe falls loosely open over a pink lace chemise and white thigh-highs as she looks over with a soft blush.
data.camera: 中景，平视，床沿与落地帘构图
data.description: 清晨阳光透过薄纱落地帘照进莫塔里主卧，珂莱塔赤足坐在丝绸床沿，象牙白真丝晨袍领口微敞，露出玫瑰蕾丝衬裙与白丝美腿。
data.lighting: 落地白纱帘透入的柔亮晨光与逆光发丝
data.location: 莫塔里庄园主卧落地窗边
data.promptProse: Bathed in soft morning sunlight filtering through sheer white curtains, Carlotta sits on the edge of her bed in an unfastened ivory silk robe over a dusty-rose lace chemise and white thigh-high stockings.
data.title: 珂莱塔 · 庄园主卧落地窗前真丝晨袍微敞
